rationale: Stop autonomous review correction after three changes-requested cycles, require the existing reviewed owner-decision chain before resuming, and give new high-risk changes a finite fault-row review boundary.
migration: Historical change, review, lifecycle, completion and receipt documents retain their released meaning. After adoption, decision windows start prospectively; a third changes-requested review requires owner resolution before another implementation cycle. New finite-boundary changes use change schema 4 and bind every finding as covered or contract-gap. Contract gaps remain open and require a superseding change rather than in-place contract mutation.
